content.title: Illinois basketball vs UConn recap in Final Four: Mullins helps Huskies reach championship game
content.text: Updated April 4, 2026, 10:20 p.m. ETThe Connecticut Huskies defeat the Illinois Fighting Illini in the first game of the Final Four at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis.Braylon Mullins, whose last-second shot pushed UConn into the Final Four, scores 15 points.Tarris Reed Jr. big man has 17 points and 11 rebounds, while Solo Ball scores 13 points.The Huskies, who won national titles in 2023 and '24, play the winner of the later Arizona-Michigan game.UConn defeats Illinois 71-62 in the Final Four at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis.Tarris Reed Jr. has 17 points and 11 rebounds to lead UConn, while 2025 Indiana Mr. Basketball Braylon Mullins scores 15 points, including 4-of-7 3-point shooting.Solo Ball scores 13 points and Alex Karaban 9 for UConn, which makes 12 3s.The Huskies — who won the 2023 and '24 national titles — meet the winner of the later game between Michigan and Arizona on Monday night, April 6, for the national championship.Keaton Wagler scores 20 points with 8 rebounds, and Tomislav Ivisic has 16 points and 7 rebounds for Illinois, which makes just 6-of-26 3-pointers.We will have score updates and highlights throughout, so remember to refresh for the latest.
